description: Rents the GPU from a quote. Costs money. Requires a quote_id from estimate_cost that the user has approved. max_spend_usd and max_hours are enforced by CloudGPU's servers: the instance is destroyed when either is reached, even if this assistant has disconnected. idle_minutes destroys it after the GPU sits idle that long (installing packages and downloading data count as idle, so allow for setup). setup_script (optional bash) runs once as root after the instance is handed over; its output is in /root/cloudgpu-setup.log.

idle_minutes.description: Destroy after the GPU has been idle this long; 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 10

max_hours.description: Hard time limit in hours (at most 24)

max_spend_usd.description: Budget for this instance in USD (at most 50)

setup_script.description: Optional bash script run once as root in the background after the instance is handed over; output in /root/cloudgpu-setup.log

user_confirmed.description: true only if the user explicitly approved this quote in the conversation

name: create_instance
title: Rent a GPU
